intro.h2: One remodeler for the bathroom and everything behind the walls
paragraphs: AMS Remodeling Inc. does bathroom remodeling in Northern Illinois, and Petr does much of the electrical and fixture work himself. That matters in a remodel: new electrical boxes, dedicated lines and plumbing fixtures are part of the job, not a separate contractor to schedule.

Our clients tend to stay. One homeowner has hired Petr for a deck, a bathroom remodel, plumbing and electrical fixtures, painting and more over six years. Another has known him for about seven years and has him do all of the family's electrical work. Both say the same thing about him: reliable, on schedule and fairly priced.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels with tile showers and new floors. The shower in our photos pairs white marble subway tile with a gray hexagon marble band, a matching hex shower floor, a ceiling rain head and a glass panel, set beside a black and white hexagon mosaic floor.

image.alt: Marble subway tile shower with gray hexagon accent band, hex mosaic shower floor and frameless glass panel

items.name: Electrical work
items.blurb: Petr handles the electrical side of remodeling: new electrical boxes, new lines out to an air conditioner condenser, dedicated circuits for clothes dryers and new light fixtures. Electric is the most mentioned topic in our Google reviews, with four mentions.

items.name: Plumbing fixture installation
items.blurb: New faucets, shower valves and other plumbing fixtures go in as part of a bathroom remodel or as a project on their own. A client of six years lists plumbing fixture installation among the many jobs Petr has done at his home.

items.name: Decks
items.blurb: Deck installation comes up in three of our Google reviews. The deck in our photos is a new pressure-treated platform with railings and wide steps down to the lawn, built off the back of a two-story home.

image.alt: New pressure-treated wood deck with spindle railings and steps behind a gray two-story house

items.name: Painting and general projects
items.blurb: Painting and the other jobs on a homeowner's list are part of the work too. Clients describe Petr as the person they call for any home project, from the first quote to the final walkthrough, because he answers questions and fits them into his schedule.

items.title: Years of repeat work
items.text: One client has worked with AMS on numerous projects over six years. Another has known Petr for about seven years and trusts him with all their electrical work.

items.title: Electrical done in-house
items.text: Reviewers call AMS great for electrical services, from new boxes to dedicated dryer lines and AC condenser lines. Electric is the top topic in our Google reviews.

items.title: On schedule, fair price
items.text: Clients say every job is completed on schedule and at a fair and affordable price. Reasonable cost is a recurring topic in our reviews.

items.title: Long hours, six days
items.text: We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM, so you can call after work or on a Saturday. Reviewers say Petr works to fit them in.

about.text: AMS Remodeling Inc. is a bathroom remodeler run day to day by Petr S. Every review we have quoted names him. Clients describe him as experienced, professional and trustworthy, someone who takes time to answer questions and goes above and beyond to make sure the customer is satisfied. Much of his work comes from the same households year after year: a bathroom, then a deck, then new circuits for appliances, then painting. If you want one person you can call for the next project, and the one after that, Petr is the person to talk to.

items.name: Josh W.
items.text:
I have worked with AMS Remodeling on numerous projects at my home over the last six years, including for a new deck, bathroom remodel, plumbing and electrical fixture installation, painting, and more.

Every job is completed on schedule with the highest degree of quality and skill, always at a fair and affordable price. I know I can rely on Petr’s experience and professionalism for any needs I have. He takes the time to answer questions and always goes above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction. I will continue to hire him for future needs because he is trustworthy and does outstanding work.

items.name: Christina T.
items.text: AMS has been great for electrical services.  Petr is very reliable and works to fit us into his schedule.  He does all our electrical work which is key to remodeling such as new electrical boxes, new lines out to the air conditioner condenser unit & adding dedicated lines for clothes dryers.  We have known Peter for about 7 years.

items.name: Gloria G.
items.text: I had a wonderful experience with Petr S. of AMS Remodeling. From initial quote to the final walk through, everything was very professional, and the quality of his work was top-notch. I highly recommend Petr for any home project. Carol K.

service_area.text: AMS Remodeling Inc. works as a service-area business, so there is no storefront to visit. We come to your home for bathroom remodels, electrical work, decks and painting. Our phone number is (847) 971-3041. Call any day from Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 8 PM, tell us your town, and we will tell you right away whether we can take on your project.

items.q: Do you do electrical work as part of a remodel?
items.a: Yes. Petr does electrical work for remodeling clients, including new electrical boxes, new lines to an air conditioner condenser unit, dedicated lines for clothes dryers and new light fixtures. One family says he does all of their electrical work and has for years.

items.q: What else do you do besides bathrooms?
items.a: Decks, plumbing fixture installation, electrical work and painting. One homeowner has hired AMS for a new deck, a bathroom remodel, plumbing and electrical fixtures, painting and more over six years. If it is on your home project list, call and ask.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM and closed on Sunday. Those longer hours make it easier to call after work or on a weekend morning. Reach us at (847) 971-3041 to talk about your project.

items.q: How do you price your work?
items.a: Every job starts with a quote after Petr sees what you need. Clients describe the price as fair and affordable, and reasonable cost is one of the topics that comes up in our Google reviews. Call (847) 971-3041 to set up a quote.

items.q: Will the job stay on schedule?
items.a: Reviewers say every job is completed on schedule, and that Petr works to fit them into his calendar when they need something done. Reliable is one of the most mentioned words in our Google reviews, with three clients using it to describe working with AMS.

final_cta.h2: Planning a bathroom or your next home project?
final_cta.text: Call Petr Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 8 PM, for a quote.
